scope: 25 hypotheses reviewed by one economics agent; these are not 25 agents
statusMeaning: supported means evidence supports the bounded mechanism/intervention, never future profitability; rejected applies only to its bounded claim; needs_data specifies unresolved empirical work

liveSpotSnapshot.source: GET http://127.0.0.1:3002/status; selected fields from read-only response

hypotheses.title: Verify actual account and product fee tiers
hypotheses.rationale: Spot uses 80 bp per side. Authenticated fee loader currently accepts PF_ derivatives only; public fees and simulated equity do not establish account entitlement.
hypotheses.testability: Extend read-only fee snapshots to spot; retain product, maker/taker rate, timestamp and expiry. Reprice fixed decisions without retuning.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: High diagnostic value; smaller costs can matter, but known daily models lose even without commission.

hypotheses.title: Test passive orders with queue-aware evidence
hypotheses.rationale: Maker fees are lower on the published entry tier, but IOC paper fills cannot validate post-only profitability.
hypotheses.testability: Compare a fixed post-only timeout policy with IOC using synchronized book/trade events, queue position, markouts, cancelled and unfilled winners.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Potential reduction in trading costs; adverse selection and missed fills can offset all savings.

hypotheses.title: Zero commission rescues the three daily candidates
hypotheses.rationale: With zero fees and 3 bp adverse price, trend, reversion and rotation still lose $1.10, $141.53 and $35.48 in final 2026 comparison.
hypotheses.testability: Already evaluated in saved fixed-decision fee-only sensitivities.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Rejects fee-only rescue for these exact candidates.

hypotheses.title: Reduce cumulative costs through infrequent funded spot positions
hypotheses.rationale: Weekly parent study had 11 episodes and $27.22 fees across almost ten years. Hourly futures trend had 493 trades and -$1,021.72 in 2024; different instruments/sizing prevent a causal strategy comparison.
hypotheses.testability: Keep the funded weekly policy frozen in paper, measure net executable returns prospectively and compare with matched-exposure alternatives. Isolate turnover in any future predeclared equal-risk comparison.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Most plausible existing cost-reduction mechanism; positive parent history is not proof and revised timing remains unvalidated.

hypotheses.title: Larger positions create positive expectancy
hypotheses.rationale: The daily models lose at the main cap and approximate $100 exposure sensitivity. Bigger allocation scales loss and risk without creating alpha.
hypotheses.testability: Saved cap sensitivity rejects a sign-rescue claim; retain realistic market impact in later sizing studies.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Avoids amplifying unproven economics.

hypotheses.title: Separate whole-account and allocated-capital returns
hypotheses.rationale: The weekly $1,175.60 profit used a $100,000 ledger and initial $100 purchase, approximately 1.176% whole-account return over the full decade. The large ledger can fund later entries after losses.
hypotheses.testability: Report total starting cash, committed capital, exposure and cash needs. A standalone $100 replay must enforce cash exhaustion and venue minimums.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Prevents overstated capital efficiency; does not generate alpha.

hypotheses.title: Value open positions after estimated selling fees
hypotheses.rationale: Spot accounting reserves an exit fee in liquidation equity while realized P&L remains zero before a sale.
hypotheses.testability: Independently reconcile cash, inventory, acquisition fees, estimated exit fees and realized/unrealized P&L. Label estimated liquidation separately from actual fills.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Prevents apparent profit from omitted costs or unclosed inventory.

hypotheses.title: Include real operating expenses and a capital hurdle
hypotheses.rationale: Reports establish trading costs but do not establish attributable infrastructure/data/transfer expenses paid by the user. These can dominate a $100 allocation.
hypotheses.testability: Collect actual attributable expenses; report trading net, business net and excess over an explicit capital benchmark separately. Do not invent interest receipts.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Material for small deployments; determines business profitability.

hypotheses.title: Compare forecasted future executable movement with exact break-even
hypotheses.rationale: 80 bp fees and 3 bp adverse price per side require about 1.674% reference-price appreciation. A 1.66% distance above a moving average is a turnover band, not a future profit forecast.
hypotheses.testability: Calculate ((1+entryFee)*(1+entrySlippage))/((1-exitFee)*(1-exitSlippage))-1; compare a calibrated future executable-return distribution and uncertainty with this hurdle.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Critical economic distinction; prevents a past move from masquerading as expected profit.

hypotheses.title: Loosen economic gates to make more profit
hypotheses.rationale: Saved actions reaching SCORE_BELOW_MINIMUM in the 14-hour audit had negative estimated means despite healthy feeds. No fills occurred.
hypotheses.testability: Record rejected opportunities and later executable returns to test forecast errors; an activity target alone does not justify relaxing gates.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Rejects an unsupported fix; estimated returns still require empirical calibration.

hypotheses.title: Faster checks improve weekly-strategy execution
hypotheses.rationale: Five-minute evaluations are active. Continuous entries resolved the old weekly window blocker, but archived-book replay ended -$3.22 liquidation P&L.
hypotheses.testability: Hold the weekly signal fixed; compare predefined monitoring schedules on event data with serialized orders, quote latency and implementation shortfall.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: May improve fills or exits; faster evaluation does not establish price predictability.

hypotheses.title: Collect all executable opportunities and decompose gross-to-net returns
hypotheses.rationale: Daily/weekly candles cannot establish executable quotes, depth, arrivals, rejects or actual order acceptance. Current journals and receipts provide useful infrastructure.
hypotheses.testability: Log every eligible/rejected decision with synchronized quotes, signal availability, intended order, fill/cancel result and fixed-horizon executable markouts. Attribute gross movement, spread, slippage, fees and funding. Freeze criteria before observing a new period.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Highest-value diagnostic: identifies whether signal, costs, constraints or execution cause failure.

hypotheses.title: Measure partial fills, dust and liquidation capacity
hypotheses.rationale: IOC paper participation is 5% of displayed quantity within a 10 bp collar. The first partial buy consumes the week opportunity; minimum rules can leave residuals.
hypotheses.testability: Report requested/filled amounts, opportunity consumption, partial-exit duration and terminal dust on recorded books. Apply conservative liquidation values.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Explains capital underuse and possible execution drag without assuming displayed depth persists.

hypotheses.title: Price asynchronous carry-leg execution risk
hypotheses.rationale: Paired historical execution and a venue-verified two-leg coordinator are absent; a mathematical hedge does not imply both orders fill.
hypotheses.testability: Shadow both legs with synchronized markets, partial fills, second-leg failure, timeouts, repair orders and explicit cash/inventory limits. Retain every one-leg loss.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Necessary to validate carry; rare repair losses can dominate small funding income.

hypotheses.title: Discounted spot fees rescue saved carry scenarios
hypotheses.rationale: All 36 declared paths remain negative at each 0/20/40/80 bp spot fee under retained futures costs, capital hurdle and basis/unwind reserves.
hypotheses.testability: Saved fee frontier already evaluates the bounded claim; current opportunities require new synchronized quotes.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Rejects this fee-only rescue; excess-return loss after reserves/hurdle differs from realized trading cash loss.

hypotheses.title: Existing long-horizon carry selector is ready for profit
hypotheses.rationale: Every development/confirmation cost and funding-timing case generated zero cycles and failed the numeric economic screen.
hypotheses.testability: Inspect saved entry rejections and compare conservative funding income with break-even; zero-trade cash is not profit evidence.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Prevents promoting an inactive selector as a solution.

hypotheses.title: Check hedge size against both venues before evaluating returns
hypotheses.rationale: Saved BTC minimum paired gross $15.7796766 exceeded the $12 cap. Larger/ETH cases were feasible but still economically negative.
hypotheses.testability: Intersect exact decimal lot sizes, minimum quantity/notional, displayed liquidity and cash/collateral limits at each timestamp.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Fixes mechanical infeasibility; capital increases alone do not fix economics.

hypotheses.title: Reconcile continuous funding separately from model and venue receipts
hypotheses.rationale: Current source includes paper funding and labels it PAPER_MODEL_NOT_VENUE_CASH_RECEIPTS. Older v13 documentation predates this implementation.
hypotheses.testability: Integrate signed absolute funding over actual exposure intervals; reconcile position-change/hour-end postings, missing rates and cash receipts. Verify deployment before claiming runtime availability.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Essential complete accounting; paper postings do not establish exchange-settled profit.

hypotheses.title: Recover exact missing funding intervals
hypotheses.rationale: 2026 channel holdout exposed three missing funding hours and full net/drawdown remained unknown. Seven missing 2025 hours reduced comparable funding-model cohorts to six months per asset.
hypotheses.testability: Obtain authoritative rates or cash postings, verify effective intervals and units, preserve failed originals and recalculate the fixed ledger. Never replace unknown funding with zero.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Can resolve uncertainty but cannot justify assuming profit.

hypotheses.title: Existing adaptive funding forecast supplies a validated advantage
hypotheses.rationale: The 30-day mean had lower 2024 MAE for both assets, while zero funding beat ETH for comparable 2025 months. Mixed forecasts do not establish a profitable paired trade.
hypotheses.testability: Existing frozen monthly cohorts test this claim; any renewed forecast must beat baselines and produce complete paired net P&L.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Avoids unnecessary complexity built on an unproven forecast.

hypotheses.title: Monitor dated carry where executable premium exceeds liabilities
hypotheses.rationale: No saved dated contract met the 30-to-90-day maturity policy. Settlement index and executable spot exit can differ.
hypotheses.testability: Monitor synchronized spot asks/futures bids for eligible expiries; include verified fees, financing, collateral, settlement and unwind assumptions. Require positive stressed cash profit and capital excess.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Potential defined convergence source; no qualifying opportunity is demonstrated in current evidence.

hypotheses.title: Improve collateral efficiency under explicit margin stress
hypotheses.rationale: Saved carry reserves 100% derivative notional and a 5% annual hurdle on spot cash plus collateral. Less collateral improves ratios but increases liquidation risk.
hypotheses.testability: Compare predefined collateral levels under applicable margin rules, haircuts, basis shocks, forced exits and replenishment costs. Report cash P&L separately from benchmark excess.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Could improve return on committed capital; deleting reserves is not evidence of safe profit.

hypotheses.title: Preserve exact rolling losses while retaining unknown legacy fees
hypotheses.rationale: v13 preflight found 102 legacy fills with missing fees outside the recent 24-hour window. Later complete windows remain computable without inventing old fees.
hypotheses.testability: Maintain boundaries, receipt uniqueness, restart and inventory invariants; report lifetime and rolling completeness separately.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Prevents wrong risk permissions and inflated historical profit; preserves an existing accounting fix.

hypotheses.title: Fee mismatch or double subtraction caused prior futures failure
hypotheses.rationale: The September 9 audit found no maker/taker mismatch or double subtraction. Paper taker cost was 5 bp per fill; the 3 bp model reserve was not a second broker fee.
hypotheses.testability: Reconcile a decision and both fills against the deployed cost pipeline if code changes; saved evidence rejects the claim for its audited version.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Prevents removing real costs to manufacture positive results.

hypotheses.title: Freeze selection and require prospective net evidence
hypotheses.rationale: Of 12 daily variants, preselected rotation earned $461.59 in 2025 H2 largely from one ETH trade, then lost $98 in 2026. Reused history and sparse episodes weaken inference.
hypotheses.testability: Predeclare family, parameters, costs, hurdle and test end. Retain every trial and assess dependent uncertainty plus cash and matched-exposure alternatives before selecting a new candidate.
hypotheses.likelyImpact: Reduces false discovery; 100 searches make disciplined selection more necessary.
